about.title: High Professionalism with a Personal Touch
about.desc1: F-Travel is a Yogyakarta-based Tour Organizer, Travel Consultant, and Event Planner that delivers travel services with professional standards and a personal touch. Armed with extensive experience in domestic and international tourism, as well as Corporate Events such as Meetings, Gatherings, Outbound trips, and special interest programs, we are trusted by various clients from private corporations, state-owned enterprises (BUMN), to personal travelers.
about.desc2: We understand that every journey brings its own unique story and purpose. Therefore, with a strong commitment to quality, flexibility, and creativity, F-Travel is always ready to deliver the best and most unforgettable experiences in every journey we design.
